MFA No.22331/2012 is filed by the United India insurance company limited, Hubballi questioning the contributory negligence and reducing the quantum of compensation.
2. MFA No.24973/2012 is filed by the claimants for seeking enhancement of compensation.

3. In this case, the factum of accident, death of deceased in the said accident and coverage of insurance are not in dispute.
4.
In the present case, the tribunal awarded compensation under various heads as follows:
Sl . No
. Heads. Amount in (Rs.)
1. Loss of dependency 4,50,000-00  2. Love and affection 15,000-00
3 . Loss of estate 15,000-00
4. Funeral and transportation 15,000-00  expenses
5. Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the material available on record.
6. Considering the grounds raised by the insurance company in the appeal memorandum, I cannot found that the car was going from Kustagi to Ilakal and Ashok Leyland lorry was coming from Ilakal

sentences.text: Spot mahazar and spot sketch prove that the car was on its correct side that is on left side of the road.
The lorry came from Ilakal to Kustagi from moving to the wrong side dashed the car.
Therefore, the driver of the lorry deviated from his lane and encroached lane of car and caused accident.
Therefore, it is proved that the driver of the lorry was rash and negligent in driving the lorry and caused accident.
In the complaint, FIR and charge sheet, allegations are made against the driver of the lorry.
Therefore, there could not be rash and negligence by the deceased while driving the car.

Therefore, tribunal is correct in holding that the driver of the lorry is completely NC:
2023:KHC-D:12393 rash and negligent in driving the lorry and caused accident.
7. The deceased was aged 22 years as on the date of accident.
The accident is of the year 01.01.2010 and in the absence of proof of income, notional income of Rs.5,500/- per month is taken into consideration.
Hence notional income is to be taken at Rs.5,500/- as recognized by the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority.

8. In view of the decision of the Hon'ble Apex Court in case of National Insurance Company Limited vs. Pranay Sethi and others, reported in (2017) 16 Supreme Court Cases 680, 40% of the income is to be added towards loss of future prospects in life.

entities.text: National Insurance Company Limited vs. Pranay Sethi and others, reported in (2017) 16 Supreme Court Cases 680
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: There are totally 5 legal heirs.
Since, deceased was bachelor, 50% of the income is to be deducted towards personal and living expenses.
Considering the age of the deceased, the appropriate applicable multiplier is 18.

Therefore, loss of dependency is re-assessed and quantified at NC: 2023:KHC-D:12393 Rs.5,500+2200 (40% of Rs.5,500) X 50/100 X 18 X 12 =Rs.8,31,600-00.
9.

In view of the decision of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Magma General Insurance Co.
Limited v. Nanu Ram & Others, reported in 2018 ACJ 2782 and in the case of Pranay Sethi supra,
the claimants are entitled to Rs.40,000/- each under the head 'loss of consortium', along with 10%
escalation.

Therefore under these heads Rs.33,000/- (Rs.15,000 x 2 + 10%) is awarded.
